scripts.build: prisma generate && node scripts/build-tailwind.mjs && next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function cp(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const ss=path.join(s,e.name),dd=path.join(d,e.name);e.isDirectory()?cp(ss,dd):fs.copyFileSync(ss,dd)}}cp('.next/static','.next/standalone/.next/static');cp('public','.next/standalone/public');console.log('Static assets copied to standalone.')"
scripts.build:electron:server: npm run build && node scripts/stage-server-resources.js && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.server.json && node scripts/cleanup-server-resources.js
scripts.build:electron:client: npm run build && node scripts/stage-client-resources.js && npx tsc -p electron-client/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.client.json && node scripts/cleanup-client-resources.js
scripts.dev:electron:client: npx tsc -p electron-client/tsconfig.json && npx electron electron-client/dist/main.js
scripts.build:android: npm run build:game-engine && npm run build:mobile-server && npm run build:crypto-lib && node scripts/sync-android-assets.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run build:game-engine && npm run build:mobile-server && node scripts/sync-android-assets.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/c/Program Files/Android/Android Studio/jbr" ANDROID_HOME="/c/Users/lngsc/AppData/Local/Android/Sdk" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.dev:electron:editor: npx tsc -p electron-editor/tsconfig.json && npx electron electron-editor/dist/main.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build && node scripts/stage-server-resources.js && node scripts/stage-client-resources.js && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -p electron-client/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.server.json && electron-builder --config electron-builder.client.json && node scripts/cleanup-server-resources.js && node scripts/cleanup-client-resources.js
